notes.note: ProjectRoom.tsx's thread seek now fetches the next window while the root is missing and the query is idle and successful, keyed on the loaded window count, the oldest cursor and a counter each fetch it started bumps on settling (fetchNextPage with cancelRefetch false), never dataUpdatedAt; a late Agent acknowledgement clears only the draft it was asked from (useRoomDraftValue writes a retired key's own storage). The paragraph's 'one window per settled page' and per-thread draft claims still hold.
ProjectRoom.tsx's round-3 changes (seek trigger, acknowledgement draft scoping) are UI only; the room routes and read-marker sections described here are unchanged.

packages/contracts/src/provider-failure.ts maps PROJECT_ROOM_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND_CODE to input_unsupported beside PROJECT_IDENTITY_NOT_PREPARED_CODE and stage_not_found (an absent target, not retryable); the contract module routing described here is unchanged.

The failure-kind table gained PROJECT_ROOM_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND_CODE as input_unsupported, matching room.projectMissing's no-retry state; ProjectRoom.tsx's seek and draft fixes keep the Shared Project room paragraph accurate (paging up to PROJECT_ROOM_HISTORY_MAX_PAGES, an open thread keeps its own draft).
